temporaryChanges.gl-error-real: GL_CheckErrors measured qglGetError with ri.Microseconds before and after; printed query_ms after querying. Removed after experiment.
temporaryChanges.gl-ignore: Moved the existing r_ignoreGLErrors early return ahead of qglGetError. Reverted after stalls moved to EndFrame.
temporaryChanges.front-buffer-valid: Original renderer behavior, r_drawBuffer GL_FRONT; redundant r_swapInterval argument removed to keep startup exec within command limit.

excludedExperiments.gl-error: Used ri.Milliseconds, which returns game-frame time. Cannot measure intra-frame wall time.
excludedExperiments.front-buffer: Added a 33rd startup command; exec probe.cfg was dropped. Q3 exceeded 45-second deadline and was terminated; no QL run. Not a music comparison.
